- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided general advice on packing essentials for a mountain trip, including:
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Clothing: layers of breathable, moisture-wicking clothing, waterproof and windproof jacket, insulated layers, warm socks, gloves, hats, scarves, quick-drying pants and shirts.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Footwear: sturdy, waterproof hiking boots or shoes with good tread, extra socks and insoles.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Safety and First Aid: first aid kit, headlamp or flashlight, extra batteries, whistle, map, compass, GPS device or smartphone with GPS app.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Hydration and Nutrition: water bottle or hydration pack, non-perishable snacks, portable water filter or purification tablets.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Shelter and Sleeping Gear: tent, sleeping bag, sleeping pad, ground tarp, camping stakes.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Personal Hygiene: biodegradable soap, toilet paper, hand sanitizer, wet wipes, baby wipes.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Miscellaneous: sunscreen, sunglasses, sun hat, insect repellent, bug netting, camera, binoculars, guidebook, trash bags, small shovel.
